English

Generated Narrative: CodeSystem KGConformanceExpectation

This case-sensitive code system http://smart.who.int/base/CodeSystem/KGConformanceExpectation defines the following codes:

CodeDisplayDefinition
SHALL SHALLSupport for the specified capability is required to be considered conformant.
SHOULD SHOULDSupport for the specified capability is strongly encouraged.
MAY MAYSupport for the specified capability is not necessary to be considered conformant.
SHOULD-NOT SHOULD NOTSupport for the specified capability is strongly discouraged.
